package gocql
	type gocql.Batch struct
		gocql.Batch field Kind cql.BatchKind
		gocql.Batch method (*T) Len() int
		gocql.Batch method (*T) Reset()
		gocql.Batch method (*T) Size() int
	type gocql.CASBatchRows[X any] struct
		gocql.CASBatchRows method (T) All(dst *cql.CASResult[X]) iter.Seq2[*cql.CASResult[X], error]
		gocql.CASBatchRows method (T) Applied() (bool, error)
		gocql.CASBatchRows method (T) Clone() (cql.CASResult[X], error)
		gocql.CASBatchRows method (T) Close() error
		gocql.CASBatchRows method (T) Columns() cql.Columns
		gocql.CASBatchRows method (T) Err() error
		gocql.CASBatchRows method (T) Info() cql.Result
		gocql.CASBatchRows method (T) NextInto(dst *cql.CASResult[X]) bool
		gocql.CASBatchRows method (T) Retain() (*gocql.PageLease, error)
	func gocql.Connect(ctx context.Context, cfg config.Config) (*gocql.Session, error)
	const gocql.MaxBatchStatements untyped int = 65535
	type gocql.Page[R any] struct
		gocql.Page method (*T) All(dst *R) iter.Seq2[*R, error]
		gocql.Page method (*T) Clone() (R, error)
		gocql.Page method (*T) Close() error
		gocql.Page method (*T) Columns() cql.Columns
		gocql.Page method (*T) Err() error
		gocql.Page method (*T) Info() cql.Result
		gocql.Page method (*T) NextInto(dst *R) bool
		gocql.Page method (*T) Retain() (*gocql.PageLease, error)
		gocql.Page method (*T) State() cql.PageState
	type gocql.PageLease struct
		gocql.PageLease method (*T) Close()
	type gocql.Prepared[P any, R any] struct
		gocql.Prepared method (*T) AddToBatch(batch *gocql.Batch, value P) error
		gocql.Prepared method (*T) All(ctx context.Context, value P, dst *R, options ...exec.CompiledOptions) iter.Seq2[*R, error]
		gocql.Prepared method (*T) Columns() cql.Columns
		gocql.Prepared method (*T) Each(ctx context.Context, value P, dst *R, fn func(*R) error, options ...exec.CompiledOptions) (cql.Result, error)
		gocql.Prepared method (*T) Exec(ctx context.Context, value P, options ...exec.CompiledOptions) (cql.Result, error)
		gocql.Prepared method (*T) Info() gocql.PreparedInfo
		gocql.Prepared method (*T) One(ctx context.Context, value P, dst *R, options ...exec.CompiledOptions) (bool, cql.Result, error)
		gocql.Prepared method (*T) Parameters() cql.Columns
		gocql.Prepared method (*T) Query(options ...exec.Options) (*gocql.Query[P, R], error)
		gocql.Prepared method (*T) Run(ctx context.Context, value P, options ...exec.CompiledOptions) (gocql.Rows[R], error)
		gocql.Prepared method (*T) RunPage(ctx context.Context, value P, state cql.PageState, pageSize int32, options ...exec.CompiledOptions) (*gocql.Page[R], error)
	type gocql.PreparedInfo struct
		gocql.PreparedInfo field Keyspace string
		gocql.PreparedInfo field Table string
		gocql.PreparedInfo field PartitionKeyIndexes []int
		gocql.PreparedInfo field Kind cql.StatementKind
		gocql.PreparedInfo field Generation uint64
	type gocql.PreparedStream[P any, R any] struct
		gocql.PreparedStream method (*T) Columns() cql.Columns
		gocql.PreparedStream method (*T) Info() gocql.PreparedInfo
		gocql.PreparedStream method (*T) Parameters() cql.Columns
		gocql.PreparedStream method (*T) Query(options ...exec.StreamOptions) (*gocql.StreamQuery[P, R], error)
	type gocql.Query[P any, R any] struct
		gocql.Query method (*T) AddToBatch(batch *gocql.Batch, value P) error
		gocql.Query method (*T) All(ctx context.Context, value P, dst *R) iter.Seq2[*R, error]
		gocql.Query method (*T) Close()
		gocql.Query method (*T) Each(ctx context.Context, value P, dst *R, fn func(*R) error) (cql.Result, error)
		gocql.Query method (*T) Exec(ctx context.Context, value P) (cql.Result, error)
		gocql.Query method (*T) One(ctx context.Context, value P, dst *R) (bool, cql.Result, error)
		gocql.Query method (*T) Routing(value P) (routing.Info, error)
		gocql.Query method (*T) Run(ctx context.Context, value P) (gocql.Rows[R], error)
		gocql.Query method (*T) RunPage(ctx context.Context, value P, state cql.PageState, pageSize int32) (*gocql.Page[R], error)
		gocql.Query method (*T) Wait(ctx context.Context) error
	type gocql.RowStream[R any] struct
		gocql.RowStream method (*T) Close() error
		gocql.RowStream method (*T) Columns() cql.Columns
		gocql.RowStream method (*T) Err() error
		gocql.RowStream method (*T) Info() gocql.StreamInfo
		gocql.RowStream method (*T) NextInto(dst *R) bool
	type gocql.Rows[R any] struct
		gocql.Rows method (T) All(dst *R) iter.Seq2[*R, error]
		gocql.Rows method (T) Clone() (R, error)
		gocql.Rows method (T) Close() error
		gocql.Rows method (T) Columns() cql.Columns
		gocql.Rows method (T) Err() error
		gocql.Rows method (T) Info() cql.Result
		gocql.Rows method (T) NextInto(dst *R) bool
		gocql.Rows method (T) Retain() (*gocql.PageLease, error)
	type gocql.Session struct
		gocql.Session method (*T) AwaitSchemaAgreement(ctx context.Context) error
		gocql.Session method (*T) Close() error
		gocql.Session method (*T) Closed() bool
		gocql.Session method (*T) CompileOptions(options exec.Options) (exec.CompiledOptions, error)
		gocql.Session method (*T) Dialect() config.Dialect
		gocql.Session method (*T) ExecBatch(ctx context.Context, batch *gocql.Batch, options ...exec.CompiledOptions) (cql.Result, error)
		gocql.Session method (*T) ID() string
		gocql.Session method (*T) Metadata() *metadata.Snapshot
		gocql.Session method (*T) Metrics() metrics.Snapshot
		gocql.Session method (*T) Prepare[P, R any](ctx context.Context, statement cql.Statement[P, R], options ...exec.PrepareOptions) (*gocql.Prepared[P, R], error)
		gocql.Session method (*T) PrepareStream[P, R any](ctx context.Context, statement cql.StreamStatement[P, R], options ...exec.PrepareOptions) (*gocql.PreparedStream[P, R], error)
		gocql.Session method (*T) RefreshMetadata(ctx context.Context) error
		gocql.Session method (*T) RunConditionalBatch[X any](ctx context.Context, batch *gocql.Batch, decoder cql.RowDecoder[cql.CASResult[X]], options ...exec.CompiledOptions) (gocql.CASBatchRows[X], error)
		gocql.Session method (*T) Subscribe(filter event.Filter) (*event.Subscription, error)
		gocql.Session method (*T) UnpreparedAddToBatch[P, R any](batch *gocql.Batch, statement cql.Statement[P, R], value P) error
		gocql.Session method (*T) UnpreparedAll[P, R any](ctx context.Context, statement cql.Statement[P, R], value P, dst *R, options ...exec.Options) iter.Seq2[*R, error]
		gocql.Session method (*T) UnpreparedEach[P, R any](ctx context.Context, statement cql.Statement[P, R], value P, dst *R, fn func(*R) error, options ...exec.Options) (cql.Result, error)
		gocql.Session method (*T) UnpreparedExec[P any](ctx context.Context, statement cql.Statement[P, cql.EmptyRow], value P, options ...exec.Options) (cql.Result, error)
		gocql.Session method (*T) UnpreparedOne[P, R any](ctx context.Context, statement cql.Statement[P, R], value P, dst *R, options ...exec.Options) (bool, cql.Result, error)
	var gocql.StopIteration error
	type gocql.StreamInfo struct
		gocql.StreamInfo field Result cql.Result
		gocql.StreamInfo field DeliveredRows int64
		gocql.StreamInfo field Pages int64
		gocql.StreamInfo field OutputStarted bool
	type gocql.StreamQuery[P any, R any] struct
		gocql.StreamQuery method (*T) Close()
		gocql.StreamQuery method (*T) Run(ctx context.Context, value P) (*gocql.RowStream[R], error)
		gocql.StreamQuery method (*T) Wait(ctx context.Context) error

package auth
	type auth.Exchange interface
		auth.Exchange method Challenge(context.Context, cql.Nullable[cql.Bytes]) (cql.Nullable[[]byte], error)
		auth.Exchange method Close()
		auth.Exchange method Success(context.Context, cql.Nullable[cql.Bytes]) error
	func auth.Password(username string, password string) auth.Provider
	type auth.Provider interface
		auth.Provider method Start(ctx context.Context, host metadata.HostSnapshot, authenticator string) (auth.Exchange, cql.Nullable[[]byte], error)

		config.ProfileBuilder method (*T) WithSpeculation(policy retry.SpeculationPolicy) *config.ProfileBuilder
		config.ProfileBuilder method (*T) WithTimeout(d time.Duration) *config.ProfileBuilder
